description:
Is hangry real, or just an excuse? Cyto breaks it down from the 6ix.

In a 2022 PLoS One study, 64 people reported their hunger and mood five times a day for 21 days (9,142 responses). Greater hunger went with more anger, more irritability and lower pleasure, even after accounting for age, sex, BMI, diet habits and trait anger. In a 2021 Appetite randomized trial, women who fasted before the lab session reported more tension, anger, fatigue and confusion and less vigour than women who ate breakfast.

The catch: the first study is observational (a link, not proof of cause), and neither study shows the mechanism. This is about everyday hunger, not a reason to skip meals.

Not medical advice. If worries about food or eating are weighing on you, talk to your doctor.
